title: Bowhead whale · reshaped adult with rebuilt skin and baleen
author: Source geometry by Marmar3; bowhead reconstruction, materials, oral anatomy and studies by PhenoVoxel Archive
surfaceType: Reshaped licensed geometry; completely new numeric skin and keratin materials; reconstructed jaw, palate, oral floor, tongue and two finely fringed baleen racks
changes: Supplied vertex colors and material discarded. Welded and simplified source exterior reshaped with a larger higher arched head, short flippers and broad flukes. A new mouth cut separates the lower jaw; the lining, tongue, paired long plates and lingual fringes are authored additions. New non-overlapping skin atlas, albedo, shallow normal and roughness fields. All finite studies retain this exterior.
biology: The fictionally named supplied sculpt is a geometric starting point, not scientific evidence or a measured animal. Scientific sources and the reference photos guide the bowhead interpretation. Selected body condition, chin islands, scars and sloughing vary among animals.

viewerRig.type: Continuous posterior flexion, separately moving lower jaw and oral floor, local orientation and paired blowhole cue
viewerRig.scope: Six finite exterior studies. No solved flow, prey capture, tissue mechanics, breathing physiology or calibrated breach trajectory.
